description: P3 coupling: the Bash wait-loop / self-match discipline governance prose lives in plugin/governance/definitions.md (`background-task completion or Monitor is **the only sanctioned wait primitive**`); the wait-loop mandate is a bullet inside that file's Bash Command Discipline section. The overlord carries no wait-loop-specific clause of its own — its coupling to this rule is the umbrella section pointer, so the consumer pins that pointer in FULL: `follow Bash Command Discipline per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md` (Bash Command Discipline)`, including the target file and section name, so retargeting the pointer at a different document or section turns the suite red. The source pattern carries the SUBJECT (background-task completion or Monitor) and not just the exclusivity predicate — rewriting WHICH primitives are the only sanctioned wait primitive must turn the suite red.

source.pattern: background-task completion or Monitor is **the only sanctioned wait primitive**

consumers.pattern: follow Bash Command Discipline per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md` (Bash Command Discipline)
